title: I have been trying to find the creator of these battlers, does anyone know?

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body:
Hi all,
I need to check the creator of these enemy battler sprites:
I think I gave the wrong credit in my demo and I want to fix that with the new patch-release.

Thanks in advance!

posts.body:
